The text explores the theme of isolation versus connection, using the lighthouse keeper’s solitude as a metaphor for the human condition. The lighthouse itself serves as a symbol of guidance and purpose, highlighting the inherent human desire to be of service and to connect with others despite physical or emotional distance. The darkness surrounding the lighthouse represents uncertainty or despair, while the light signifies hope and direction.
